design_intent: A maintained high-altitude refuge: a complete south arrival portal, a stone wind compass, four elevated creature roosts, visible supplies and warm landing signals give the six inherited needles human and creature scale without changing the Fly route or survey landing disc.
_arrival_arch_camera_stops_note: Measured from WallEntranceBricks.obj scaled to arrival_arch_size_m: the aperture spans the middle half of the width and tops out at 64% of the height. Piers and lintel get occlusion-only camera stops (camera_rig OCCLUSION_ONLY_LAYER); traversal collision is unchanged.
_banner_masts_note: The first two banners hang on the arrival arch face; the two side banners stand on open lawn and get their own timber mast and crossbar (frame-matrix M1, frame 20: a banner floating in the sky).
_composition_note: The south portal is the ordinary Fly arrival silhouette. The compass preserves a clear central landing target, while the raised roost crossbars and supply clusters occupy the former empty lawn at trainer-readable height. All additions are visual-only.
_arrival_portal_note: F08#3 arrival-lip: the solid WallEntranceBricks arch across the south Fly line hid the landing for the last 25 m of every arrival. 'pylons' keeps two free-standing SimpleTowerBricks gate pylons (pier width = size.x/2 - opening_half) with occlusion-only camera stops and no lintel; 'arch' restores the old portal.
_needle_feet_note: F08#3: [x, z, radius] of the six visual-only needles (no collision; Fly and landing are owned by the terrain and survey disc). Re-spaced so the south Fly arrival (x 0, z<0), the north landing/departure lane and the NW vista toward Cliffhold are open; the production camera no longer sits wedged between two needles after a landing.
_compass_note: F08#3: the outer ring was a 0.5 m gold tube that read as a rail across the lens of the landed/route frames; it is now a 0.2 m inlay, flattened (presentation _add_ring).
